children: A Safe{DAO} draft proposal is live for discussion to fund Safenet Aegis, a production-ready protocol release designed to secure the Safe ecosystem. Under the proposal, onchain fees generated by the release would be paid to network participants, creating a direct distribution mechanism tied to protocol usage. The draft is currently in its discussion phase, where DAO members can review, debate, and refine the terms before any vote.

If approved, Safenet Aegis would give the SAFE token a direct fee-revenue and utility channel, since network participants receive onchain fees from a production release rather than from a separate incentive program. That structure links token demand to actual protocol activity securing the Safe ecosystem. The proposal remains a draft, so funding, fee parameters, and timing all depend on the outcome of governance discussion and any subsequent vote.
Draft Proposal for Safenet is live on the Safe{DAO} forum for discussion:
It asks to fund Safenet Aegis: The first production-ready protocol release to secure the
ecosystem and the first, with onchain fees paid to participants in the network.

title: Safe: Safenet Aegis Proposal Draft Live for DAO Discussion to Fund Ecosystem Security Release - 17 Sep 2026
